methods: Codex hook trust record absent/present state unit test
temporary allowlist export from which hook-trust-status reported REVIEW_REQUIRED without changing trust

result.temporary_export: REVIEW_REQUIRED reported with no project trust record; no hook or Codex config was changed

limitations: Codex does not expose a non-interactive command that confirms a persisted record still matches the current hook hash.
If Codex reports a changed hook needs re-review, the user must review it in `/hooks`.
The change is local and unreleased; remote CI and desktop UI execution are outside this validation.
